scene: Metal Magnate, eight company tiles / 38 standing objects
renderer: Godot 4.6.2 OpenGL compatibility, Apple M5 Pro
notes: Frame intervals include HUD and forced rendering; these are not isolated GPU timings.
Near framing culls more tiles, so it has fewer draw calls.
The whole-game texture monitor includes the regular map and prewarmed building sprites.
Initial cold captures included approximately 150 ms spikes.
Across these revision captures, medians varied from about 4.0 to 6.8 ms and p95 reached 14.3 ms. OS/window scheduling affects these forced-draw intervals; do not interpret them as a GPU speed-up.
